item.title: Israel warns citizens outside country to be on alert for Iranian terror attacks
item.description: Israelis abroad were urged to carefully monitor surroundings when in areas identified with Israel or Judaism and not to enter into areas known for hostility toward Israelis and Jews. The post Israel warns citizens outside country to be on alert for Iranian terror attacks appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Arab states condemn Iranian missile strikes after attacks on US interests and allies
item.description: Iran fired missiles at US bases in Gulf States excluding Oman, which played a mediating role between the US and Iran during nuclear talks. The post Arab states condemn Iranian missile strikes after attacks on US interests and allies appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: WATCH: CENTCOM publishes footage of attack on Iran
item.description: Footage shows U.S. warplanes taking off from American aircraft carriers and Tomahawk land-attack missiles being launched from U.S. Navy destroyers, striking Iranian infrastructure, regime leaders, and additional targets. The post WATCH: CENTCOM publishes footage of attack on Iran appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Iran strikes UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan
item.description: Saudi Arabia, where no hits were reported, condemned Iranian attacks targeting its neighbors in a statement by the kingdom’s official press agency. The post Iran strikes UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Israeli officials expect Iran conflict to continue for several days to a week
item.description: Israeli authorities said that, as of Saturday, there were no confirmed Israeli civilian fatalities resulting from the Iranian strikes. The post Israeli officials expect Iran conflict to continue for several days to a week appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: WATCH: Iranians celebrate the news of Khamenei’s death
item.description: Hundreds of Iranians have taken to the streets and chanted from rooftops after multiple sources confirmed the death of Ayatollah Khamenei, marking the end of his tyrannical and murderous rule. The post WATCH: Iranians celebrate the news of Khamenei’s death appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, head of the Iranian regime, confirmed dead
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and senior officials from Israel’s security establishment were presented with a photograph purportedly showing Khamenei’s body. The post Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, head of the Iranian regime, confirmed dead appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: WATCH: One dead, dozens wounded as Iranian missile impacts in Tel Aviv
item.description: Following a recent missile strike in Tel Aviv, a woman in her 40s died from her injuries, while several other Israelis were wounded to varying degrees. The post WATCH: One dead, dozens wounded as Iranian missile impacts in Tel Aviv appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: One killed, 22 injured in Tel Aviv after Iranian missile strike
item.description: Iran fired as many as 200 missiles were fired into Israel in response to a US-Israel operation that began on Saturday morning. The post One killed, 22 injured in Tel Aviv after Iranian missile strike appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Trump responds to Iranian threats, predicts regime change after Khamenei killed
item.description: President Trump warns the US will hit Iran 'with a force that has never been seen before' if Tehran follows through on its threats to ramp up its strikes on US allies.
